versions.changelog:
Initial release of evolving-agent: an AI programming system coordinator

- Introduces a main process supervisor role to manage the entire task lifecycle.
- Supports intent recognition and automated module dispatch for programming, knowledge inducting, and learning tasks.
- Integrates health checks and stepwise monitoring of subtask progress and outputs.
- Enforces results auditing and experience extraction upon task completion.
- Provides quick reference commands for managing evolution mode, knowledge base, GitHub integration, and project detection.
